_help: Team roles for the Desk's Team tab and sidebar. cli: claude | codex (or give a full argv). model: what that CLI's --model / -m takes. prompt: a file in roles/ added to the agent's system prompt. icon: an svg in icons/, without .svg. worktree: true for roles that edit code; such a role gets its own git worktree when another agent is already working in that checkout. Saved edits show within a few seconds. on_request: true for roles that start only when Kabeer asks (team start needs --requested; the Desk's buttons pass it). bin/team starts every role; roles/protocol.md is added to every role's prompt.
